title: 第731章 女娲船长寰宇万界进攻天庭第730章 大战将启三大反骨仔的激动
slug: 西游开局获得太白金星传承
lines: 阴阳道人点头，抚须而笑：“合该如此。”
“让他们先打，打得两败俱伤。”
“到时候，我等再出来收拾残局。”
恰在这时，他俩感应到了什么。
望向无尽混沌一处。
只见一方浩瀚的混沌海延展开来。
浩浩荡荡，无边无垠。
混沌之气翻涌，地水火风交织，大道法则流转。
仿佛一方世界在诞生，仿佛一方宇宙在演化。
而从混沌海上，竟然驶来了一艘极其浩大的战船！
那战船，横亘亿万里，遮天蔽日，镇压万古。
船身由混沌神金铸就，大道法则铭刻其上，时空本源流淌其间。
帆影如天幕，旗帜猎猎，仿佛从混沌尽头驶来。
阴阳道人和乾坤道人看向那艘战船。
只见这战船上有大量生灵在忙活。
这些生灵有强有弱，气息各异。
不过在阴阳道人和乾坤道人眼中，自然不算什么。
蝼蚁而已，尘埃罢了，不值一提。
真正让他们在意的是，在那生灵之中，有一位女子。
这位女子身穿一袭简单的衣衫。
素衣白裙，不施粉黛，不着珠翠。
但却挡不住其超凡入圣之气质，风华绝代都难以形容其万一，倾国倾城都不过是俗世之语。
大道法则在其身周自然流转，无尽道韵在其脚下自行臣服。
仿佛大道之主，仿佛混沌之源，仿佛万物之母。
阴阳道人和乾坤道人互相看了一眼。
都看向了对方眼中的震动。
以他俩之能，竟然完全看不透这女子。
仿佛雾里看花，仿佛镜中窥影。
而此刻，战船之上。
一位生灵向着那女子禀告道：“大人，前方发现两个混沌生灵，实力不明，态度不明，是否要战斗。”
那女子不满道：“说了多少次，要叫我女王大人！”
语气顿了顿，目光扫向乾坤道人和阴阳道人。
眼神一动，随即摇头道：“不必在意，全速前进，目标，混沌魔神。”
“是，遵命！”
下一瞬，这艘战船便全速前进。
content_en:
Taoist Yin Yang nodded, stroked his beard and smiled: "That's how it should be."
"Let them fight first, and both sides will be injured."
"When the time comes, I'll come out and clean up the mess."
Just at this moment, the two of them sensed something.
Looking into the endless chaos.
I saw a vast sea of ​​chaos spreading out.
Vast and boundless.
The energy of chaos surges, earth, water, fire and wind intertwine, and the laws of the great avenue circulate.
It’s as if a world is being born, as if a universe is evolving.
And from the Chaos Sea, an extremely huge warship came unexpectedly!
That warship spans hundreds of millions of miles, covers the sky and the sun, and suppresses it for eternity.
The hull is made of the divine gold of chaos, with the laws of the Great Dao engraved on it, and the origin of time and space flowing through it.
The shadow of the sail is like the sky, and the flag is hunting, as if it is coming from the end of chaos.
Taoist Yin Yang and Taoist Qiankun looked at the warship.
I saw a large number of creatures busy on the warship.
These creatures are strong and weak, with different auras.
But in the eyes of Yin Yang Taoist and Qian Kun Taoist, nature is nothing.
They are just ants and dust, not worth mentioning.
What really concerned them was that among the creatures, there was a woman.
The woman was wearing a simple dress.
Plain clothes and white skirts, no pink or pearls.
But it cannot stop his extraordinary and saintly temperament. It is difficult to describe his extraordinary splendor, and the words "powerful the country and the city" are just worldly words.
The laws of the great road flow naturally around him, and the endless charm of the road surrenders at his feet.
Like the master of the avenue, like the source of chaos, like the mother of all things.
"This is..."
Taoist Yin Yang and Taoist Qiankun looked at each other.
They all looked at the shock in each other's eyes.
With their abilities, they couldn't see through this woman at all.
It's like seeing flowers in the fog, like seeing shadows in the mirror.
At this moment, on the warship.
A creature reported to the woman: "Sir, two chaotic creatures were found in front of us. Their strength and attitude are unknown. Whether they want to fight or not."
The woman was dissatisfied and said: "How many times have I told you to call me Queen!"
His tone paused, and his eyes glanced at Taoist Qiankun and Taoist Yin-Yang.
His eyes moved, then he shook his head and said: "Don't worry, move forward at full speed, the target is the Chaos Demon God."
"Yes, obey!"
The next moment, the warship moved forward at full speed.
